mitre_attack_techniques.signature_description: Enumerates the modules from a process (may be used to locate base addresses in process injection)
Reads from the memory of another process
At least one IP Address, Domain, or File Name was found in a crypto call
The PE file contains an overlay
Guard pages use detected - possible anti-debugging.
May use bcdedit to modify the Windows boot settings
Checks if the current process is being debugged
Allocates memory with a write watch (potentially for evading sandboxes)
Creates guard pages, often used to prevent reverse engineering and debugging
Launches processes in debugging mode, may be used to hinder debugging
Binary contains a suspicious time stamp
Checks if the current process is being debugged
Queries the volume information (name, serial number etc) of a device

text_highlighted: Check online for a solution and close the program
